title: NEON lake zooplankton, RELEASE-2026: animals of 207 taxa counted per tow or trap sample, about three samples per bout and three bouts a year at 7 NEON lakes, 2014-2024 (without IUCN-threatened taxa; coordinates as published)
creator: NEON (National Ecological Observatory Network)
citation: NEON (National Ecological Observatory Network). Zooplankton collection (DP1.20219.001), RELEASE-2026. https://doi.org/10.48443/6p6g-d296. Dataset accessed from https://data.neonscience.org/data-products/DP1.20219.001/RELEASE-2026 on 2026-11-12
abstract: NEON's lake zooplankton survey: in spring, summer and fall bouts a sample is taken near the profiling buoy and at two littoral sensor sets, by vertical tow net where the water is deeper than 4 m and by Schindler-Patalas trap elsewhere, preserved and sent to a taxonomy laboratory, which counts and identifies the animals in coarse and fine subsamples of known volume. This table is the number of animals of each taxon counted in each sample; obs_subsample_fraction gives the share of the sample they were counted in, and the whole-bottle estimate is not shipped. The taxa surveyed for at a lake are the per-lake pool of taxa this table records there (median 91 of 207; __survey_taxa). Lake-centre coordinates are as NEON publishes them; the IUCN-threatened copepod Hesperodiaptomus augustaensis is not in this table (neon_2026_zooplankton_count has it, with coarsened coordinates).
samplingProtocol: Vertical tow net (water deeper than 4 m) or Schindler-Patalas trap (shallower), one composite sample near the profiling buoy and one at each of two littoral sensor sets, three bouts a year; samples preserved in ethanol, subsampled (coarse and fine fractions of known volume) and counted and identified by a taxonomy laboratory (NEON AOS zooplankton sampling protocol)
surveyEvidenceNote: zoo_fieldData lists every sample (with samplingImpractical where one was not taken); a survey is a sample with samplingImpractical blank and laboratory rows in zoo_taxonomyProcessed. The zeros rest on a per-lake species pool derived from detections (ruling 19): the taxa surveyed for at a lake are every taxon this table records at that lake in any sample (__survey_taxa), not a list NEON deposited.
closureNote: occasion = sample within one bout, taken on one day at the buoy and the littoral sensor sets (two per location in two 2014 bouts); period = bout (spring, summer, fall), indexed globally by date
geographicCoverage: 7 NEON lake sites in Florida, Wisconsin, North Dakota and Alaska; lake-centre coordinates as published by NEON (WGS 84) in __units; latitude 29.7 to 68.6, longitude -149.6 to -82.0

coordinatesCoarsened.method: As published by NEON (lake-centre coordinates with coordinateUncertaintyInMeters in __units). The IUCN-threatened taxa (Hesperodiaptomus augustaensis (VU)) are not in this table (E7 scope, 3); neon_2026_zooplankton_count has them, with coordinates coarsened.

covariateNote: obs_location = NEON sampling location (buoy.c0 / buoy.c1 near the buoy, littoral1-3 at the littoral sensor sets); obs_sampler_type = tow net or Schindler-Patalas; obs_tows = tows or traps composited into the sample; obs_volume_l = litres of lake water sampled (effort); obs_n_nauplii = nauplii among the animals counted (within y); obs_subsample_fraction (subsampleColumn) = for a counted taxon, its counted animals over NEON's adjCountPerBottle (the share of the bottle it was counted in), for a taxon not found, the largest share of the bottle examined in any subsample of the sample (zooSubsampleVolume / estConcentratedSampleVolume, capped at 1); it may vary across taxa within a sample (E5).
notes: y = animals counted by the laboratory, summed over the coarse and fine subsamples and over nauplii and later stages (nauplii as obs_n_nauplii); NEON's whole-bottle estimate adjCountPerBottle, whose volumes the readme's issue log corrects for 2015-2023, is not shipped and does not enter y. Per-lake pools (ruling 19): median 91 taxa (range 68-110). Taxa: 114 species (subspecies rolled up) and 94 records identified only to a higher rank or to a species complex, each its own taxon (E6); 1 pairs of NEON 'sp.' and 'spp.' codes merged (ruling 20). Surveys: 615 samples in 204 bouts; 9 samples not taken (logistical); 2 samples dropped (a laboratory row marked damaged, affecting analysis). Other per-row sample conditions (damaged, affecting taxonomy or measurement) are kept. Seven lakes: below the sample floor of 30 units.

notShipped.threatened: Hesperodiaptomus augustaensis (VU); records identified only to a higher rank stay in both tables (E7 scope, 3)
notShipped.samples not used: 9 samples not taken (samplingImpractical logistical); 2 with a laboratory row marked damaged, affecting analysis
notShipped.whole-bottle estimate: adjCountPerBottle (the count scaled to the whole bottle; y and obs_subsample_fraction are shipped)
notShipped.other fields: body length and width summaries, zoo_perSample QC metrics, identification history, zoo_perVial and zoo_taxonomyRaw (expanded package)
notShipped.zeros outside the lake pool: a taxon never recorded at a lake has no rows there (per-lake pool, ruling 19)
